name: Hornero Metronome
description: Metronome 2.0: compact bar metronome with a popover (BPM slider plus minus/plus), deadline-scheduled beats that skip missed beats after sleep, and optional first-beat accent. No processes, no network.
author: HorneroOS contributors

bpm.description: Metronome tempo in beats per minute (40-208).

beatsPerBar.description: Beats per bar used for the accented first beat.

accentFirstBeat.description: Flash the first beat of each bar in the accent colour.

changelog.notes: Productivity Timers 2.0: compact indicator plus popover with BPM slider, deadline-scheduled beats (missed beats after sleep are skipped), bpm setting now declares its 40-208 bounds, optional first-beat accent, Theme tokens and Argentine Spanish translation.
Bar metronome with flashing beat indicator and persisted BPM setting (default 96, clamped 40-208).
